green_provenance.label_semantics: Inherited original-probe constants, not a sampled execution Git HEAD. The original receipt is preserved unchanged.
green_provenance.clarification: Final GREEN behavior is tied to its raw command CLI/source fingerprints and the same committed fix source. Original e1c3e08/b3a31ea labels do not assert that the old binary passed.

timestamp_note: Controller independent command started_at fields are receipt capture timestamps after the subprocess, not process-start timestamps. Raw streams/exit and monotonic outer elapsed values are preserved.
limitations: Full original test and audit results with selected synthetic author/source inputs. No scientific, arbitrary semantics, conversion, production Vault, cross-platform, or scale benchmark acceptance inferred.
